# Or Nuri (אור נורי)

> Or Nuri is a Senior Tech Lead at monday.com who leads strategic AI initiatives across R&D, including teams of autonomous AI agents that find and fix accessibility issues all the way to production. He founded adjusti.co (bootstrapped, acquired by Teikametrics in 2020), holds an MSc in Machine Learning & Data Science from Reichman University (IDC Herzliya), and advises AI startups.

Official website: https://or-nuri.com/

## Roles

- Senior Tech Lead / AI & Tech Leader, monday.com (2021-present): leads strategic AI initiatives across R&D; previously tech led the AI-first Collaborative Work Management group (~20 developers), WorkForms and WorkDocs.
- Head of Engineering, Teikametrics (2020-2021): led engineering after the adjusti.co acquisition.
- Founder & CTO, adjusti.co (2019-2020): ecommerce market intelligence for Amazon and Walmart, 2,000+ brands, zero external funding, acquired by Teikametrics.
- R&D Manager, iCast Audio Books (2016-2017, later acquired by Storytel).
- Advisory board member, Record (AI customer support); startup advisor on AI integration, ML architecture and engineering teams.

## Projects

- Autonomous AI agents at monday.com: one team of agents scans the product for accessibility issues, a second team plans and ships each fix to production.
- WorkForms (forms by monday.com): scaled from tens of thousands to tens of millions of daily requests; availability 89% to 99.9%.
- adjusti.co: market intelligence datasets powering AI bidding, acquired by Teikametrics (2020).

## Education

- MSc, Machine Learning & Data Science, Reichman University (IDC Herzliya)
- BSc, Computer Science, Reichman University (IDC Herzliya)
- Zell Entrepreneurship Program alumnus
